# swarmbus
> Shared-memory lease and claim table for separate processes (mmap, 64 slots), plus an in-process blackboard and compute-budget auction, in Zig 0.16. Prototype with known concurrency defects.

- `swarmbus lease|claim|read <shm_path> ...`: fenced leases and last-writer-wins claims in a 64-slot shared-memory table.
- `swarmbus auction ...`: greedy compute-budget auction (utility per token).
- `swarmbus bench`: in-process Blackboard claim latency only; cross-process latency is unmeasured.
- Known defects: a lease can overwrite an unrelated claim (#2); duplicate lease holder and torn claims found by review (#3).

README.md is the source of truth, including measured numbers with hardware and commit.
